Amendments to the Credit Agreement . Effective as of the date of satisfaction of the conditions precedent set forth in Section 2 below, the parties hereto agree to amend the Credit Agreement as follows: (a) Section 1.1 of the

Indebtedness outstanding on such date, minus (b) the aggregate amount of all unencumbered cash and Cash Equivalent Investments of the Borrower held on deposit that, in the aggregate, exceeds $200,000,000, to (ii) Consolidated EBITDA for

effectiveness of this Amendment is subject to the satisfaction of the following conditions precedent: (a) The Administrative Agent shall have received counterparts of this Amendment duly executed by the Borrower, the Lenders and the

# Investment Memorandum

## 1. Executive Summary

- On April 15, 2022, Bio-Rad Laboratories, Inc. entered into Amendment No. 2 to their original Credit Agreement dated April 15, 2019.
- Bio-Rad Laboratories, Inc. serves as the Borrower, with JPMorgan Chase Bank, N.A. acting as Administrative Agent and lead lender alongside a syndicate including Bank of America, HSBC Bank USA, MUFG Union Bank, Citibank, Wells Fargo Bank, Bank of the West, Citizens Bank, and U.S. Bank National Association.
- The amendment modifies two key provisions: (1) the "Leverage Ratio" definition to provide more favorable treatment by allowing cash and cash equivalent investments exceeding $200 million to be netted against consolidated funded indebtedness, and (2) extends financial reporting deadlines from 90 to 120 days for annual reports and from 45 to 60 days for quarterly reports.
- The purpose appears to be providing Bio-Rad with more favorable covenant calculations and additional operational flexibility in financial reporting timelines.

## 2. Investment Highlights & Risks

### Key Strengths / Credit Positives:
- Strong banking consortium comprising major U.S. financial institutions (JPMorgan Chase, Bank of America, Wells Fargo, Citibank, and others), indicating significant lender confidence in Bio-Rad's credit profile
- Bio-Rad maintains compliance with all existing covenants and representations, with no defaults or unmatured defaults reported
- The borrower appears to have substantial cash holdings, as evidenced by the $200 million cash threshold in the amended leverage ratio calculation

### Principal Risks and Mitigating Factors:
- The amendments are generally borrower-friendly, potentially indicating some financial stress or desire for additional covenant headroom
- Extended reporting deadlines could reduce transparency and delay identification of potential issues
- Limited visibility into overall deal size, pricing, or maturity given the amendment-only nature of this document

- On April 15, 2022, Bio-Rad Laboratories, Inc. entered into Amendment No. 2 to their original Credit Agreement dated April 15, 2019.

- The borrower appears to have substantial cash holdings, as evidenced by the $200 million cash threshold in the amended leverage ratio calculation

### Principal Risks and Mitigating Factors:
- The amendments are generally borrower-friendly, potentially indicating some financial stress or desire for additional covenant headroom
- Extended reporting deadlines could reduce transparency and delay identification of potential issues
- Limited visibility into overall deal size, pricing, or maturity given the amendment-only nature of this document
